description: Returns the live visit reports of a place or record page: counts (reports, people who went, would recommend, by context), a score from 0 to 1, and the comments, each labeled "A resident of <neighborhood>" or "A visitor" with the month. No names. An unknown page returns { "error": "not_found" }.

page.description: A page URL or path on littlemilwaukee.com, or a place or record slug.

name: get_visit_reports
